title: Henselian valuative local rings and punctured-local stalk calculation
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair with $I$ finitely generated, let $A'=\widehat A$ be its $I$-adic completion, and put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $U=X\setminus V(I)$ and $U'=\operatorname{Spec}A'\times_XU$ [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For each finitely generated ideal $J$ with $V(J)=V(I)$ write $Y_J=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$, and write $Y'_J$ for the corresponding blowup over $A'$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. Let $\mathcal T$ and $L^q_F,L^q_{F'}$ be the limit topos and colimit sheaves of [lem-per-admissible-modification-cohomology-presentation], for a torsion abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $U$ and its inverse image $F'$ on $U'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. There is a conservative family of compatible geometric points $t=(\bar t_J)$ of the closed fibres for which the following holds. Form
$$B_t=\varinjlim_J\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y_J,\bar t_J},\qquad B'_t=\varinjlim_J\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y'_J,\bar t'_J}$$
using the compatible points on corresponding closed fibres and strict henselizations [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. These are nonzero henselian local rings, with the induced local map $u_t:B_t\to B'_t$. There is a nonunit nonzerodivisor $\varphi_t\in B_t$ such that $IB_t=(\varphi_t)$ and $IB'_t=(\varphi'_t)$ for $\varphi'_t=u_t(\varphi_t)$, also a nonunit nonzerodivisor. In each ring every finitely generated ideal containing a positive power of its displayed principal ideal is principal and generated by a nonzerodivisor; this is the $I$-valuative property used here. Put $S_t=B_t[1/\varphi_t]$, $S'_t=B'_t[1/\varphi'_t]$, and let $F_t$ be the inverse image of $F$ under $\operatorname{Spec}S_t\to U$, with $F'_t$ its inverse image on $\operatorname{Spec}S'_t$. There are canonical restriction isomorphisms, for every $q\geq0$,
$$(L^q_F)_t\simeq H^q((\operatorname{Spec}S_t)_{\mathrm{et}},F_t),\qquad (L^q_{F'})_t\simeq H^q((\operatorname{Spec}S'_t)_{\mathrm{et}},F'_t).$$
Under these isomorphisms the exchange morphism on stalks is the pullback induced by $S_t\to S'_t$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].
